name: Ochimizu Kyouka
source:
One of the producers of Love Meets Bonds Festival. Ochimizu has a mature, professional, and prideful personality, coinciding with her years of experience in the entertainment industry. Very often, she is shown to be cold and look down on others, specifically [url=https://vndb.org/c46554]Rise[/url], making derogatory remarks and being highly intolerant of immature or amateurish behaviors. Ochimizu can be extremely strict on the idols and performers she works with, and many times she uses shameless tactics to promote them, such as broadcasting footage of her harshly pushing Kanamin Kitchen so the public will sympathize with them. She often makes up weird scenarios to help her idols get into their role.

[From [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Kyoka_Ochimizu]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
